invariants.rationale: Null paths are checked at the start of the method; typically, projectFilePath should be non-null when meaningful processing occurs.
The method returns early if projectFilePath is null or empty (whitespace-insensitive), so substantive logic expects a non-empty string.
Non-empty after trim implies original length is greater than zero, unless only whitespace was passed.
A string with only whitespace causes early return; otherwise, further processing is performed.
Both checks are used at method entry for early return – the 'real work' path requires both true.
